newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS AT NEW LOWS ON KEY CURRENCIES.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS AT NEW LOWS ON KEY CURRENCIES.

text.p: Short-covering, speculation and contined import pressure sent the Zimbabwe dollar to fresh record lows against hard currencies on Friday, dealers said.
"Real trade (importer demand) is still there but I think people are also taking strategic positions. One would rather not be caught short in a declining market," said one dealer.

The Reserve Bank supported the local currency by selling U.S. dollars into the market during the day in quantities described by another dealer as enough to "smoothen the depreciation and maintain market confidence".
By the close the local unit had lost four cents against the U.S. currency with dealers forecasting no let-up in coming weeks, as Zimbabwe's traditional import season gathers pace.
The Zimbabwean currency closed at 10.5000/5200 to the U.S. dollar against 10.4550/4750 on Thursday.
Against pound sterling the dollar fell to 16.5300/5700 from 16.3610/4000 on Thursday and to 6.8600/8800 from 6.8360/8510 against the German mark.
Against the South African rand, the Zimbabwe dollar eased to 2.3100/3132 from 2.2930/3010 overnight.
